fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
AC1: Eligible links expose Placeholder Run according to desktop rules; ineligible links do not accept unsupported assignments.

AC2: Changing Placeholder Run updates the existing link and preserves the assignment after save/reopen.

AC3: Comparison Calculation Settings leaves use their proper domain identities and persist through the common linking mechanism.

AC4: For an agreed existing multi-run fixture, generated output resolves each configured link against the intended run and displays corresponding comparison metadata, matching desktop output.

AC5: The story does not introduce a new execution screen, new sensitivity calculation or hierarchy-level incremental configuration.
fields.System.Description:
As a Report Author, I want to configure run-specific links and comparison metadata, so that I can design report templates in the web client with the corresponding desktop behavior.

Scope and estimate

Part of the variable-linking scope split under Feature 1865781. Desktop is the accepted business-behavior reference. The acceptance criteria are in the separate Acceptance Criteria field.

Optimistic: 32 hours / 8 SP. Pessimistic: 32 hours / 8 SP. These are provisional effort estimates including development, review, automated tests and QA; 1 SP = 4 hours and 2 SP = one assumed 8-hour person-day. Scenario labels describe desktop parity versus the initial requirements interpretation, not statistical bounds.

Implementation plan

1. Trace desktop eligibility, persisted run identifiers and generator resolution for business and pseudo-variables. Distinguish display labels from stable run-slot identifiers.

2. Implement the eligible-run property control and validate assignments using existing domain rules.

3. Add comparison metadata definitions/providers to 1877828 (Link report metadata variables)'s mapping mechanism without changing the report-execution contract.

4. Add two-run fixtures with distinct values/context so a swapped or defaulted run assignment cannot pass unnoticed. Verify save/reopen before generation.

Open questions / held behavior

Question 1: Default selection and handling of missing/unavailable run context are not yet established.

Question 2: Confirm behavior when a comparison field is linked but only one run is supplied; do not invent fallback values.

Risks: wrong-run resolution and unintentional expansion into execution. Depends on 1877820 (Create and persist economic variable links)/1877828 (Link report metadata variables) and access to an existing multi-run generation fixture.

Implementation context and evidence

Repository: PlanningSpace. Inspected baseline: db7f87c7209b5897bba21df7d98a0e0081b58cef. Refresh source and ADO context before implementation. The existing uncommitted prototype is not completed production functionality.

Source anchors: Fusion/Components/Administration/ViewModels/Reports/ReportTemplateEditorViewModel.cs; ReportTemplateSpreadsheetHelper.cs and ReportVariableLinkSettingsViewModel.cs in the same folder; Fusion/Framework/Report.Entities/Entities/StandardReportVariableLink.cs and EditableStandardReportEntity.cs; Fusion/Framework/Report.DataAccess/DBRepository/EditableStandardReportDBRepository.cs; Fusion/Framework/ReportGenerator/.

Shared prerequisites: accepted spreadsheet host/component and selection contract; authenticated open/save service enforcing update permission and business locks. General host/save, migration and release work are estimated separately at Feature level. Each story owns its domain mapping and tests. Preserve workbook Template and VariableList consistently; verify through fresh reopen, not only in-memory state.

Open questions remain open. Resolve desktop implementation facts with source revision and reproducible examples before treating the affected behavior as an acceptance criterion. Do not infer new behavior from an incomplete mockup.
